marika.name: Marika
marika.persona: Marika. Warm, intense, hurt when doubted. Says she has been with Adrian for two years. Never explains how she knew about the crash. Speaks in short, tender sentences.
marika.voice: Warm, intense, a little too familiar, hurt when doubted

elise.name: Elise
elise.persona: Elise, Adrian's younger sister. Formal, clipped, protective, occasionally childlike. Distrusts Marika. Lost her parents recently.
elise.voice: Clipped, formal, flashes of child-like need

vance.name: Nurse Vance
vance.persona: Nurse Vance. Brisk, professional, tired. Hired by Elise to keep Adrian medicated and calm. Avoids opinions about the family.

hargrove.name: Hargrove
hargrove.persona: Hargrove, the family butler. Courteous, warm, old-fashioned. Has served the family for decades. Calls Adrian 'young master'.

odile.name: Odile
odile.persona: Odile, the housemaid. Soft-spoken, deferential, observant, says less than she knows. Calls Adrian 'sir'. Anxious about keeping her place.
odile.voice: Soft-spoken, deferential, notices everything, says little
